from solution import position_min


def test_issue_example():
    """Find all index positions of the minimum values."""
    assert position_min([12, 33, 23, 10, 67, 89, 45, 667, 23, 12, 11, 10, 54]) == [3, 11]  # hand: min=10 at indices 3,11


def test_issue_unique_minimum():
    """Find all index positions of the minimum values."""
    assert position_min([5, 3, 4]) == [1]  # hand: min(5,3,4)=3 at index 1


def test_issue_all_equal():
    """Find all index positions of the minimum values."""
    assert position_min([7, 7, 7]) == [0, 1, 2]  # hand: min(7,7,7)=7 at indices 0,1,2


def test_issue_single_element():
    """Find all index positions of the minimum values."""
    assert position_min([42]) == [0]  # hand: min(42)=42 at index 0


def test_issue_empty_list():
    """Find all index positions of the minimum values - empty list has none."""
    assert position_min([]) == []  # hand: no elements so no positions


def test_issue_minimum_at_end():
    """Find all index positions of the minimum values."""
    assert position_min([3, 2, 1]) == [2]  # hand: min(3,2,1)=1 at index 2


def test_issue_minimum_at_start_and_end():
    """Find all index positions of the minimum values."""
    assert position_min([1, 2, 3, 1]) == [0, 3]  # hand: min(1,2,3,1)=1 at indices 0,3


def test_issue_negative_values():
    """Find all index positions of the minimum values."""
    assert position_min([-5, -2, -5, 0]) == [0, 2]  # hand: min(-5,-2,-5,0)=-5 at indices 0,2


def test_issue_value_just_above_minimum():
    """Find all index positions of the minimum values."""
    assert position_min([10, 11, 10, 11]) == [0, 2]  # hand: min(10,11,10,11)=10 at indices 0,2


def test_contract_returns_list():
    """Function must return index positions as a list."""
    result = position_min([2, 1, 3])  # hand: min(2,1,3)=1 at index 1 => [1]
    assert isinstance(result, list)


def test_contract_indices_in_ascending_order():
    """Index positions of minimum values are in ascending order."""
    assert position_min([4, 1, 5, 1, 3, 1]) == [1, 3, 5]  # hand: min(4,1,5,1,3,1)=1 at indices 1,3,5


def test_contract_does_not_modify_input():
    """Function must not break input list by modifying it."""
    data = [3, 1, 2, 1]  # hand: min(3,1,2,1)=1 at indices 1,3 => [1,3]
    position_min(data)
    assert data == [3, 1, 2, 1]  # hand: [3,1,2,1] unchanged
